decisive_items: 7 cm × 5 cm × 5 cm heterogenous left adrenal mass containing regions of necrosis
local extension into and invasion of the pancreatic tail, left hemidiaphragm, and spleen
response.rationale: Large necrotic adrenal mass with local invasion and lymphadenopathy strongly favors adrenal cortical carcinoma over alternatives; family history of renal cell carcinoma is only indirect, and pheochromocytoma lacks typical symptoms.

rejected.why: No paroxysmal hypertension or catecholamine symptoms; adrenal mass alone is nonspecific.
Systemic symptoms and lymph nodes are nonspecific; imaging shows adrenal origin not nodal mass.
Family history is a risk factor but no renal mass; adrenal mass with local invasion is more primary adrenal.
Autoimmune history and azathioprine are context, but imaging shows a necrotic invasive mass, not diffuse adrenalitis.
